title: qSOFA in 60 Seconds: Sepsis Criteria
description:
qSOFA (Sepsis-3, 2016): respiratory rate 22 or more, altered mentation, systolic BP 100 or less. Two or more points flags a higher risk of poor outcome. The 2021 Surviving Sepsis Campaign guidelines recommend against using qSOFA alone as a screening tool compared with SIRS, NEWS or MEWS.

Sources:
• Singer M et al. Sepsis-3 definitions. JAMA 2016: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26903338/
• Evans L et al. Surviving Sepsis Campaign guidelines 2021. Crit Care Med: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34605781/

✅ Fact-checked as of 23 Nov 2026. Medical evidence and guidelines change; check the sources above for updates.
